answer: Re-attestations are stored in saffron and dune lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the canyon graph. A farm of 2496 identities would post 2086 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
